guard_interpretation: Initial fresh import stopped at the 2 GiB additional disk budget, then continued from its own cache within a 512 MiB allowance.
First graphical NUnit run stopped below 3 GiB host free RAM; no XML was produced, so no test verdict was assigned.
CPU lifecycle tests subsequently used -nographics and --burst-disable-compilation; rendered six-scene UI ran with graphics and Burst compilation disabled.
Host disk deltas include concurrent OS activity; observed pagefile allocation does not explain or attribute the entire earlier growth.
Package caches were not shared or junctioned: byte audit found a generated ARCore test asset difference.
All figures are five-second samples, not continuous hardware peaks.
not_accepted: Fresh Android builds of this combined tree; existing four APKs were built from the main workspace
